text: {"bull":["Sales rose 18% to ₹3,470 cr in Q1 FY27 versus ₹2,859 cr a year ago, showing strong demand growth.","Operating profit increased to ₹6,16 cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹6,24 cr a year earlier, maintaining an OPM of 21% and indicating margin resilience.","Domestic sales grew 22% to ₹2,854 cr in Q1 FY27, underscoring robust domestic market performance.","Net profit reached ₹6,09 cr in Q1 FY27, up from ₹6,04 cr a year earlier, reflecting effective cost management amid commodity inflation."],"bear":["Operating profit fell to ₹6,16 cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹6,24 cr a year earlier, with OPM dropping to 18% in Q2 FY27, signalling margin pressure.","Net profit dipped to ₹6,09 cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹6,04 cr a year earlier, indicating narrowing earnings.","Exports remained flat at ₹5,21 cr in Q1 FY27, showing limited international growth.","Commodity cost inflation and freight challenges were highlighted as key factors impacting margins in the FY27 call."]}
